deltas.reason: HTTP_JSON Resubscribe divergence surfaced by shadow: (a) subtests including java_v10 fail on both OLD and NEW because a2a-java's HttpClient closes the chunked-transfer body prematurely on resubscribe (java.io.EOFException in agent_java_v10.log — pre-existing bug, orthogonal to the launcher cutover); (b) subtests without java pass on NEW (launcher-fetched a2a-rs main) but fail on OLD because the baked v10 baseline is stale relative to Rust main. One parent entry covers all 12 sub-outcomes; suppresses_real_failure=true is required because the java-side failures are REAL_FAILURE (NEW fails oracle), not just divergences. Remove this entry once the java Resubscribe bug is fixed upstream AND the baked baseline is refreshed OR deleted (Story S17).
